evidence.quote: Today I would like to address both the "who" and the "what" issues in the regulation of international banking.
Basel III enhanced the quantity and quality of capital requirements and introduced, for the first time, quantitative liquidity standards.
We have calibrated our proposed internal TLAC requirements slightly below our proposed external TLAC requirements for U.S. GSIBs.

parsed.rationale: The speech addresses the cross-border regulation and supervision of international banks, covering capital rules, TLAC and home-host responsibilities. It offers no view on monetary policy, inflation or economic activity, so the stance is neutral.
